description: Requote an unexecuted intent without another order or debit. Supply its current quote_version (initially 1). Returns the same intent_id, a new quote_version and up to five more minutes, at most three renewals within thirty minutes. Show the latest price/details and ask for confirmation again; execute with the returned version. Retrying the same input returns the saved renewal. Expired paid inquiries are not repeated automatically.
name: renew_purchase
title: Perbarui harga pesanan yang disiapkan
